title: House Safety Standards Matrix for Roamhaven Listings
content:
# House Safety Standards Matrix

*Trust and Safety — standards that apply to every Roamhaven Listings listing according to its space type.*

The house standards cover four matters: smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, cameras inside the listing, exterior cameras and noise monitors, and parties and events. The matrix states, space type by space type, which standard applies.

| Space type | Working smoke and carbon monoxide alarms must be declared before publishing | Any camera inside the listing allowed | Exterior cameras and noise monitors must be disclosed on the listing | Global ban on parties and events applies |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shared Room | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Private Room | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Entire Guest Suite | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Entire Apartment | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Entire Home | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Luxury Villa | yes | no | yes | yes |

## Reading the matrix

- **Alarms.** For every space type, working smoke and carbon monoxide alarms must be declared before the listing is published.
- **Indoor cameras.** No space type allows any camera to be placed inside the listing.
- **Exterior devices.** For every space type, each exterior camera and each noise monitor must be disclosed on the listing.
- **Parties and events.** The global ban on parties and events applies to every space type.

## Questions the matrix answers

**Does a Shared Room listing in the host's own home follow a lighter camera standard than an Entire Home?**
No. The indoor-camera standard is the same for all six space types: no camera may be placed inside the listing.

**May a Luxury Villa host an event because the whole home is rented?**
No. The ban on parties and events applies to the Luxury Villa exactly as it applies to every other space type.
